description:
Otay Mountain, California

Accidentally flushed from an erosion rill within a bare area, next to a trail surrounded by chaparral at 14:34. Did not see the owl until it flushed. Owl flew northwest, turned east, and went down in chaparral cover out of site (approximately 10 meters away). Gave off alarm call when two CORA flew overhead, then flew up to approximately 100 feet, circled a few times, then flew south out of view. Probably a resting migrant - bare area in trail virtually surrounded by thick chaparral (dominated by Arctostaphylos otayensis, Pickeringia montana, and Adenostoma fasciculatum). No other BUOW observed.
